components.name: Badge
components.intent: Compact status label. Crisis mode keeps colors but forces opaque surfaces.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text (design-core renders it as children).

components.name: BottomNav
components.intent: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile-first apps. Use for primary app navigation.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback when the active item changes.

components.name: Button
components.intent: Primary action button. Use for CTAs, form submissions, and key actions.

components.name: CalmIndicator
components.intent: Calm pill in the status cluster — reads spoon level and opens the calm overlay.

components.name: CalmOverlay
components.intent: Calm-mode overlay shown at spoon level 0. Breathing circle rest stop. Store-agnostic — spoons/onReturn are props.

props.name: spoons
props.description: Current spoon level; calm activates at 0.

props.name: onExit
props.description: Called when the user exits calm.

props.name: onSessionEnd
props.description: Called when a calm session ends.

components.name: CandyHeader
components.intent: Candy-rounded glass header for the sovereign stack.

components.name: Card
components.intent: Elevated surface with an optional interactive affordance.

components.name: Chameleon
components.intent: Adaptive theme controls: brand × world × age × sensory modes. Zero-reload token swaps.

components.name: ChatShell
components.intent: Conversational shell with a header, drawer, and chat surface.

components.name: Checkbox
components.intent: Tri-state checkbox (checked / unchecked / indeterminate).

components.name: CommandPalette
components.intent: Keyboard-friendly command palette (⌘K). Use for site-wide search and command invocation.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the selected item id.

components.name: CommandTrigger
components.intent: Topbar search affordance — a button with a keyboard hint that opens the command palette.

components.name: CrisisOverlay
components.intent: Full-screen crisis mode overlay. Shown when spoons=0. Only exit control visible.

components.name: Crown
components.intent: Compact brand crown mark with a label.

components.name: Dropdown
components.intent: Selectable dropdown menu with options.

components.name: Footer
components.intent: Site footer with configurable columns, branding, and legal text.

components.name: GlassCard
components.intent: Padded glassmorphic card for content grouping. Use for feature cards, paper listings, and content tiles.

props.name: href
props.description: Deprecated — use <GlassCard strong> with a wrapping <a>.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Deprecated — use a wrapping element onClick.

components.name: GlassPanel
components.intent: Elevated glassmorphic surface with backdrop blur. Use for modals, drawers, and elevated content areas.

components.name: MetricBadge
components.intent: Compact metric display with icon. Use for dashboard KPIs and telemetry.

components.name: MobileBottomNav
components.intent: Mobile bottom navigation bar — flagship items only (suite pattern). Store-agnostic.

components.name: ModePill
components.intent: Primary mode control (SPARK / MAKER / WORKSHOP) with a tone dot.

components.name: NotificationStack
components.intent: Stacked, severity-tinted notification toasts (bottom-right). Store-agnostic — items/onDismiss are props; colors via data-kind.

components.name: PageHeader
components.intent: Inner-page hero: mono eyebrow, gradient title, and lede. Use at the top of content routes.

components.name: SectionStrip
components.intent: Desktop pill navigation strip. Use for primary section navigation on wide viewports.

components.name: SidebarNav
components.intent: Flat suite navigation rail (emoji + label), active state per route. Store-agnostic — items/activePath/onNavigate are props.

components.name: SpoonCluster
components.intent: Spoon dots in the status cluster — read-only metabolic status.

components.name: SpoonDial
components.intent: Cognitive load selector (0-5 spoons). Use for neurodivergent-first accessibility control.

props.name: onCrisis
props.description: Calm rest button — sets level to its minimum.

components.name: Starfield
components.intent: Animated starfield background. Use for ambient backgrounds in shell and marketing.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.intent: Status indicator badge. Use for system status, health indicators, and state labels.

components.name: StatusCluster
components.intent: Read-only status row in the topbar right region. Scrolls horizontally with edge fades when it outgrows the bar.

components.name: TopbarSection
components.intent: Vertically-centered, gap-consistent slot group inside a Topbar. Owns internal spacing; the Topbar owns arrangement.

components.name: Topbar
components.intent: Unified app-chrome shell — slot-based three-region layout. Brand / center / statusCluster / mode / trailing, with variant (app|marketing|game) and mobile overrides.
